alerts.title: Assam floods: death toll tops 100, 2,700 villages destroyed, 700K displaced
alerts.summary: Weeks of catastrophic monsoon flooding across Assam — worst in Sivasagar, Nazira, Charaideo and Jorhat districts — have now killed more than 100 people, destroyed roughly 2,700 villages and displaced 700,000 people, with the state government putting total affected population at 1.2 million. Residents describe tsunami-like surges that swept away homes and livestock; several rivers remain above danger levels, keeping the risk of fresh flooding elevated.
alerts.impact: Critical serviceability loss — Upper Assam (Sivasagar/Nazira/Charaideo/Jorhat): keep NS flags active for flood-hit pincodes, coordinate with Delhivery/Xpressbees for alternate NE routing around Guwahati hub, and expect extended non-adherence in this belt for at least another 1-2 weeks given rivers remain above danger mark.

alerts.title: Himachal Pradesh: Pandoh landslide shuts Kiratpur-Manali NH, 333 roads blocked, 2,000 vehicles stranded
alerts.summary: Fresh landslides near Pandoh (Baglamukhi ropeway and Jogni Mata Temple stretches) have shut the Kiratpur-Manali National Highway between Mandi and Kullu, stranding around 2,000 vehicles. 333 roads are blocked in Mandi district alone. Authorities have opened an alternative diversion road from Pandoh and set up relief camps at Pandoh and Aut with food, shelter and essentials for stranded drivers.
alerts.impact: Serviceability loss risk — Mandi/Kullu/Manali corridor: hold non-time-critical linehaul through the Kiratpur-Manali NH until NHAI confirms reopening, route via the Pandoh diversion where possible, and pre-build 3-5 day buffer stock at Mandi/Kullu hubs. Flag Manali-bound LM as at-risk given this is the single main road link.

alerts.title: North Odisha floods: Jalka crosses danger mark at Mathani, 90 villages at risk in Basta block
alerts.summary: Two more days of incessant rain have pushed the Baitarani above the danger mark at Anandapur and the Jalka past its danger level at Mathani in Balasore's Basta block (7.84m vs 6.50m danger mark at 6am). Around 90 villages across 17 panchayats in Basta block are at risk if rain continues, with floodwater entering low-lying areas and road connectivity affected at multiple locations; administration has shifted vulnerable residents to flood shelters.
alerts.impact: Critical serviceability loss — Balasore/Basta belt: flag Basta-block pincodes non-serviceable while river levels stay above the danger mark, hold linehaul into the Baleswar/Bhadrak hub, and pre-position buffer stock at Bhubaneswar for re-routing once roads reopen.

alerts.title: Manipur: flash floods/landslides isolate border villages across Senapati, Ukhrul & Kamjong hill districts
alerts.summary: Two days of incessant rain triggered flash floods and landslides across Manipur's Senapati, Ukhrul and Kamjong hill districts, damaging farmland, roads and bridges and cutting off several remote border villages from essential services. The Ngaorei (Laini) river, which runs along the Ukhrul-Senapati border, crossed the danger mark.
alerts.impact: Serviceability loss risk — Ukhrul/Senapati/Kamjong pincodes: flag remote border villages as NS until bridge/road repairs complete; route Imphal-hub linehaul via alternate NH2 stretches and monitor for extended non-adherence in hill-district LM.

alerts.title: Meghalaya: Shillong-Dawki road shut after major landslide; Mawsynram records 526.5mm rain
alerts.summary: A major landslide has completely cut off the Shillong-Dawki road — the key link to the Bangladesh border trade point — after Mawsynram in East Khasi Hills recorded 526.5mm of rain, among the highest in the region. The East Khasi Hills Deputy Commissioner has closed the road until further notice; repair work is expected to take a few days.
alerts.impact: LM disruption — East Khasi Hills/Dawki corridor: flag Dawki-route pincodes non-serviceable, hold cross-border-linked shipments, and use alternate Shillong-Jowai routing where feasible for the next several days.

alerts.title: Darjeeling hills: landslide on Jorebungalow-Teesta Bazar road via Peshok disrupts Darjeeling-Sikkim traffic
alerts.summary: A heavy landslide on the Jorebungalow-Teesta Bazar road via Peshok in Darjeeling district caused part of the road to disappear, halting traffic on this key Darjeeling-Kalimpong-Gangtok link for goods and passenger vehicles. One-way traffic has since been arranged while PWD repairs the site; more rain is forecast for Darjeeling, Jalpaiguri and Alipurduar.
alerts.impact: Watch list — Darjeeling/Kalimpong/Gangtok LM: expect delays on this hill corridor; build extra transit buffer for Sikkim-bound dispatches and monitor for repeat blockages given further rain forecast.

alerts.title: Telangana: yellow alert for 13 districts as Bay of Bengal depression brings heavy rain, reservoirs rising
alerts.summary: A depression/trough over the Bay of Bengal brought heavy to extremely heavy rain to Telangana, prompting a yellow alert across 13 districts from the Hyderabad Meteorological Centre; reservoirs are rising and residents in Hyderabad and surrounding districts have been advised to stay alert.
alerts.impact: Watch list — Hyderabad hub and northern Telangana pincodes: pre-position buffer stock and be ready to relax SLAs if the depression intensifies; monitor the Kamareddy/Medak/Nirmal belt, historically first to see village-road cutoffs in this rain pattern.

alerts.title: Telangana auto/cab strike called off hours before Aug 24 start, talks planned next month
alerts.summary: Auto-rickshaw, cab (Ola/Uber/Rapido) and school-van unions under the JAC banner called off their planned indefinite strike hours before its Sunday midnight start, after transport minister Ponnam Prabhakar assured talks on their demands — a welfare board, ₹12,000 annual assistance and ₹5 lakh accident insurance — next month. Hyderabad and other Telangana cities avoided disruption to commute, food and grocery delivery.
alerts.impact: Watch list, no current disruption: Hyderabad hub LM/FM unaffected today, but the underlying gig/auto-worker demands remain unresolved and talks are only scheduled for next month — treat as a recurring strike-risk watch item and revisit before the next JAC deadline.

alerts.title: Petrol/diesel hold steady at multi-city highs amid Strait of Hormuz shipping relief
alerts.summary: Retail petrol and diesel prices remain unchanged since OMCs' May 25 hike — Delhi ₹102.12/₹95.20, Mumbai ₹111.21/₹97.83, Bengaluru ₹111.68/₹99.56, Hyderabad ₹115.69/₹103.82, Chennai ₹107.76/₹99.55, Kolkata ₹113.51/₹99.82 (petrol/diesel per litre). Prices have settled after the latest US-Iran de-escalation raised hopes of resumed shipping via the Strait of Hormuz.
alerts.impact: Cost watch, no action yet: no immediate LM/FM disruption, but sustained high fuel levels keep pressure on 3P per-km rates. Track weekly for early signal on Delhivery/Shadowfax/Xpressbees fuel surcharge asks ahead of the next pricing cycle.

alerts.title: Punjab Bandh (Aug 21, 7am-2pm): statewide shutdown over Bandi Singhs release demand
alerts.summary: Qaumi Insaaf Morcha has called a 7-hour statewide bandh across Punjab today (7am-2pm), demanding release of Sikh prisoners (Bandi Singhs) who have completed their sentences but remain in jail. The call followed an August 15 confrontation between demonstrators and police near the Chandigarh-Mohali border. Private schools are staying open and hospitals/medical stores are exempted, but markets, public transport and road movement are expected to be most affected statewide.
alerts.impact: LM/FM risk, statewide but time-boxed: Expect road-movement and market disruption across Punjab and Chandigarh during the 7am-2pm window today. Hold non-time-critical linehaul/dispatches until after 2pm, flag same-day deliveries in affected towns as at-risk, and avoid penalizing 3P non-adherence for today's Punjab routes.

alerts.title: Kullu: landslide caves in NH-305 at Dugasari village (Kamand panchayat); Baliyol road also blocked
alerts.summary: Intense overnight rain triggered a landslide at Dugasari village in Kamand panchayat, Kullu, causing a section of the Aut-Luhri-Sainj National Highway (NH-305) to cave in and trapping a vehicle. Separately, the Anni-Gugra-Chowai road near Baliyol village was blocked by another landslide. IMD has an orange alert out for Kullu with heavy rain expected to continue till Aug 21.
alerts.impact: LM/FM risk in Kullu's Banjar-Sainj-Anni belt: expect delivery delays/non-adherence for pincodes served via NH-305. Hold NS flags for Kamand/Banjar-area villages and route around via alternate valley roads until PWD clears the cave-in.

alerts.title: Himachal Pradesh: 3 killed in Sirmaur landslide, 88 roads blocked statewide as monsoon toll hits 197
alerts.summary: A landslide in Sirmaur district killed three people as heavy rain blocked 88 roads across the state. Mandi (32 blocked roads) and Kullu (25) are worst hit, with 161 power transformers down for over a week. State monsoon death toll has reached 197 (81 from floods/landslides). Yellow alert issued for Aug 19 in Shimla, Kangra, Kullu, Mandi, Hamirpur, Sirmaur and Chamba.
alerts.impact: Serviceability loss risk across Mandi/Kullu/Sirmaur hubs: maintain NS flags for cut-off pincodes, pre-build 3-5 day buffer stock at Shimla/Mandi hubs, and relax SLA for hill-route LM partners until road-clearance count improves.

alerts.title: North Odisha floods: 5 lakh affected, Mathani village (Basta) inundated as Baitarani, Brahmani rivers swell
alerts.summary: Rising water in the Baitarani, Brahmani, Salandi, Jalaka and Budhabalanga rivers has flooded roughly 503 villages across 52 blocks, affecting 2.7 lakh people directly (5 lakh region-wide); Mathani village in Basta block remains inundated. IMD red warning is active for Balasore, Keonjhar and Mayurbhanj districts with a fresh Bay of Bengal low pressure area threatening more rain; over 2.37 lakh people evacuated to relief camps.
alerts.impact: Critical serviceability loss — Balasore/Keonjhar/Mayurbhanj pincodes: flag as non-serviceable until floodwaters recede, hold linehaul into Baleswar/Bhadrak hub, and pre-position buffer stock at Bhubaneswar for re-routing once roads reopen.

alerts.title: Assam: Dikhow river floods wipe out Nepalikhuti village near Nazira; 476 villages hit since mid-July
alerts.summary: Since July 19, catastrophic flooding of the Dikhow river has affected 476 villages and 5.74 lakh people across Sivasagar, Nazira, Charaideo and Jorhat districts, submerging 28,356 hectares of cropland. Nepalikhuti village near Nazira (close to the Assam-Nagaland border) was among the worst hit — around 10 deaths and roughly 5,000 cattle swept away. Relief work continues at Holongkatoni village near Nazira.
alerts.impact: Serviceability loss — Upper Assam (Sivasagar/Nazira/Jorhat): keep NS flags active for Dikhow-basin pincodes, coordinate Delhivery/Xpressbees for alternate NE routing around Guwahati hub, and expect extended non-adherence in Charaideo/Sivasagar for at least another 1-2 weeks.

alerts.title: Uttarakhand: widespread landslides cut off 80 villages from Rudraprayag district
alerts.summary: Heavy rainfall triggered widespread landslides across Uttarakhand, blocking key roads and cutting off around 80 villages — the worst-hit area being Rudraprayag district — from neighbouring towns, limiting access to food and healthcare. Rescue and relief efforts have been slowed by continued blocked roads.
alerts.impact: Serviceability loss risk — Rudraprayag hill pincodes: maintain NS flags for isolated villages, and continue monitoring since mountain-road repairs in this belt typically take several weeks; keep alternate Rishikesh-hub routing on standby.

alerts.title: Jammu-Srinagar NH44: daytime-only travel advised at Dewal (Udhampur) & Marog-Kishtwari Pather single-lane stretches
alerts.summary: NH44 has reopened for light motor vehicles from both sides but remains restricted to single-lane movement at Dewal (Udhampur) and between Marog and Kishtwari Pather; Traffic Control Units are advising daytime-only travel and warning against night travel between Ramban and Banihal due to landslide and shooting-stone risk.
alerts.impact: Watch list — Valley-bound linehaul via NH44: continue building extra transit time into Srinagar/Baramulla/Anantnag TATs, avoid scheduling night dispatches on this stretch, and keep buffer stock at Jammu hub given the corridor's recurring single-lane bottlenecks.

alerts.summary: A depression/trough over the Bay of Bengal is bringing heavy to extremely heavy rain to Telangana today, prompting a yellow alert across 13 districts from the Hyderabad Meteorological Centre; reservoirs are rising and residents in Hyderabad and surrounding districts have been advised to stay alert.

alerts.title: Petrol/diesel hold at multi-city highs; commercial LPG cylinder price falls ₹194 in Mumbai
alerts.summary: Retail petrol and diesel prices remain steady but elevated — Delhi ₹102.12/petrol, Mumbai ₹111.21 petrol/₹97.97 diesel, Bengaluru ₹111.68, Hyderabad ₹115.69, Kolkata ₹113.51. Domestic LPG is unchanged month-on-month, while commercial (19kg) LPG cylinder prices fell by up to ₹194 in Mumbai this cycle.
alerts.impact: Cost watch, no action yet: no immediate LM/FM disruption, but sustained high retail fuel levels keep pressure on 3P per-km rates. Track weekly for early signal on Delhivery/Shadowfax/Xpressbees fuel surcharge asks ahead of the next pricing cycle.
